version: Open grass arenas with giant radius-based beans and single-click zero-cooldown attacks
coverage: 22 selected behavior tests only. Full 1000-map data loops, unrelated behavior tests and 100 enemy-type hit loops were filtered out, not executed, and are not counted as passes. Generated data is separately covered by the single level_design audit.
tests: one pointer gesture fires one bubble, independent of how many simulation frames it spans
rapid distinct clicks each fire once without waiting for animation or cooldown
F and J each fire once per physical press while key repeat does not add shots
keyboard activation of the button fires once and non-primary clicks do not attack
three weapons are selectable and unknown choices leave the equipped weapon unchanged
weapon switching is immediate during attack animations and the next attack uses the new weapon
eight explicit attack actions emit eight real bubbles without waiting for animation or cooldown
1000 stable unique map codes with deterministic representative open arenas
map 100 has only 1/5/10 beans and map 101 unlocks one 100 and one 500 giant bean
walking into each visible giant bean collects at its outer edge once, before reaching the center
giant bean contact also works on raised ground using its base height
1, 5 and 10 point beans accumulate independently of count; exact score wins once without duplicate points
crossing a score target wins even when no collection hits the threshold exactly
100 and 500 point beans add their full scores once and can cross the target
pause and both portal directions preserve 500-point rewards without recollecting them
falling and respawning retain score and beans; restarting resets both
portals require leaving the exit before re-entry and preserve existing score without recollection
keyboard actions retain jump, roll, dive and cooldown physics
picking up a shield schedules a 100-second refresh, pause freezes time, holding one does not consume a refreshed pickup
a shield blocks exactly one ordinary or boss contact without damage or knockback
manual return and falling clear the shield while preserving bean score; restart resets pickups
teleportation retains the equipped one-hit shield
ruleVersion: Open arena baseline before subtract/zero beans and positive bean replenishment
